dct_title_s: Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of) - Earthquake on Sep 25 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rcrj](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rcrj) Magnitude 5.8 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Sep 25 2025 26km NW of Sabana Grande. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 9.894 longitude -70.6699. It impacted 244499 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
